I struggle with insomnia and have issues with puffiness and discoloration under my eyes and these really help! I keep mine stored in the refrigerator to A. Get extra relief when I wear them B. Get extra help with the puffiness and C. They stick way better on my face when they are cold. I cannot recommend these enough, I'm so glad I got these!
